note: An example is one jsonl record: a TTS-spoken user query at t=0 and speak-head labels in seconds. Alert records carry only the literal label 'alert' at every positive second (no response text; all other seconds are silent); narration records carry caption text at segment-transition seconds over a directory of 2 fps frames. No clips: the media sit inside 40 GB / 114 GB gzip tarballs that cannot be range-read, and the videos are re-hosted OOPS (YouTube), DiDeMo, Charades and ActivityNet footage. Narration times are seconds of the re-timed record (its frame list starts mid-video and unlabeled gaps were cut), not of the original ActivityNet video.
